statement: Build a one-file, mobile-first website for Brew Lab, a cafe in Indiranagar, Bengaluru. It shows the menu with prices, opening hours (8am to 10pm every day) and the location, and lets visitors pre-order coffee for pickup.
audience: People in and around Indiranagar, Bengaluru who want to check the menu, hours and location, or pre-order coffee for pickup, mostly on their phones.
standards: Mobile-first layout: base styles for small screens, wider layouts added with min-width media queries
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step (CDN libraries allowed)
rules: Do not invent facts the Requester has not given (menu items, prices, address, phone, photos); show them as visibly marked placeholders
Opening hours are exactly 8am to 10pm, every day
Do not claim an order is confirmed or paid unless a real order channel exists in the file; until then the pre-order flow must state that it is a request for pickup
done_when: The page title and header show the name Brew Lab and mention Indiranagar, Bengaluru
A menu section lists items grouped by category, each with a name and a price in ₹; any price not supplied is visibly marked as a placeholder
An opening hours section states 8am to 10pm for every day of the week
A location section names Indiranagar, Bengaluru and includes a map link or embed; the street address is visibly marked as a placeholder until supplied
A pre-order form lets a visitor choose coffee items and quantities, enter a name and a pickup time, see a running total, and submit
The file has a viewport meta tag, its base CSS targets small screens, and it uses min-width media queries for larger screens
The layout has no horizontal scrolling at 360px width
The site is a single HTML file with no build step and no local file dependencies
Every placeholder is visibly marked so it can be told apart from real content
open_inputs: Where pre-orders should go (for example WhatsApp, email or an ordering service) and whether payment is taken online
Logo, photos and brand colours if any
Language (English only assumed unless told otherwise)
